dedupe_keys.name: emergency department demand and cause specific mortality in chile harmonized national weekly panel out of sample predictions and complete result tables 2008 2026

description: The research authors publish a harmonised weekly Chilean panel linking emergency-department attendance, cause-specific mortality and population denominators. Zenodo supplies a manifest and data ZIP under CC BY 4.0. The record reports 170,080 observations by region, age band, domain and week from 2008–2026, plus out-of-sample prediction tables, screening decisions and register-audit reports. The accompanying software is separately licensed MIT. This panel can help calibrate emergency-care demand and test mortality-warning components in healthcare simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this derived panel. Coverage is national and aggregated; visits cannot be linked to individual deaths. A limitation is that the historic state of the mortality register cannot be reconstructed from one harvest and temperature, pollution and virus covariates are absent. The publisher documents a corrected baseline after finding an earlier evaluation problem. No ZIP was downloaded or forecast reproduced.
